title: Grateful Dead Live at College Of William & Mary Hall on 1973-09-12
source: Master Soundboard Reels to DAT 16 bit 44.1kHz from ANON Also, a Kind LL member shared uncirculated lo-fi audience tapes to patch a few spots

ai_review.summary: Mellow, average show with a nice Bird Song and smooth Eyes→Stella transition, but the soundboard suffers from splices and early audio problems.
ai_review.review: The performance is generally laid‑back and middle‑of‑the‑road, highlighted by a pleasant Bird Song and an effective transition from Eyes to Stella; however the horn section on "Weather Report Suite > Let It Grow" divides listeners. The recording is a soundboard source that starts out with noticeable audio glitches, splices in Bertha, and a missing "Don't Ease Me In", though it steadies after the early part of the set.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews average the show at about three stars and note significant recording issues; combined weighting yields an overall rating around average.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Early audio difficulties, splices in Bertha, cuts of "Don't Ease Me In", and general uneven sound quality despite improvement later in the set.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall mellow and laid‑back vibe reminiscent of 1974, with horns on "Weather Report Suite > Let It Grow" seen as a detractor by some listeners.
